title: Sector Overview #1 | Luxury Goods | October 2026
author: Alexis Rondeaux
summary: The luxury market is stabilising, not recovering: Q3 2026 broke the recovery narrative as China's tax crackdown hit the top cohort, hard luxury outgrew fashion, and sector leaders now trade at decade-low multiples.
key_takeaways: Personal luxury goods: €358bn in 2025, Bain base case +2-4% for 2026
Q3 2026: LVMH Fashion & Leather -5%, Gucci -6%, Hermès +4.3% (slowest since 2020)
China top-25 brand sales fell >10% in July 2026
LVMH, Hermès, Kering down ~40% YTD; LVMH ~16x forward P/E
disclaimer: Student research for educational purposes only. Not investment advice.
